summary: Full test pass on the new MCP / API Token manager feature. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_mcp_tokens.py (22 cases) covering: /admin/mcp auth-gate + page load, /api/admin/mcp-tokens CRUD (list/create/validation/patch-revoke/delete), permission enforcement on /api/mcp/blog (blog:read allows GET & rejects POST with 401; blog:write rejects GET; bogus & no-key both 401), revoke->401 / reactivate->200 flow, delete removes access, past-dated expiresAt yields status='expired' + 401, public pages regression. All 22 tests PASS. Re-ran /app/backend/tests/test_bsa_admin.py - 18/18 still PASS. Playwright UI verified: sidebar 'Sistem' group shows 'Token MCP / API' link, navigates to /admin/mcp, token-name-input/token-expiry-select/perm-blog:read/perm-blog:write/generate-token-btn all work, success box renders the new token (format bsagrc_mcp_<48 hex>) with copy button, new row appears in Daftar Token with correct name + 'Aktif' status badge + 'blog:read' permission badge + Cabut/Hapus buttons. Test data cleaned (no TEST_ tokens remain in DB).

minor.issue: Uses 401 for permission-mismatch (has valid token but missing permission). Semantically 403 is more accurate; not blocking but slightly less RESTful.
Body flag semantics: {revoked:false} reactivates, {revoked:true} revokes, and omitting the field defaults to revoke. Works, but consider explicit action=revoke|reactivate for clarity.

issues: The 'Cara pakai' <code> block also uses class 'font-mono' which is identical to the just-created token code element - a more specific selector/testid on the new-token code would improve testability (minor). Existing header <Image> aspect-ratio Next.js warning still present (pre-existing carryover).

critical_code_review_comments: lib/tokens.ts: validateToken correctly checks revoked -> expired -> permission in that order and returns typed reasons; lastUsedAt is updated fire-and-forget (non-blocking) which is correct.

app/api/mcp/blog/route.ts: checkAuth is now async and awaits validateToken - legacy env-key fallback preserved. Consider returning 403 (instead of 401) when key is valid but permission missing, so clients can distinguish 'unknown key' vs 'insufficient scope'.

app/api/admin/mcp-tokens/route.ts: routes are guarded only by admin middleware (assumed via cookie); explicit auth check inside handlers would be defense-in-depth. Currently relying on Next middleware which is fine given /api/admin/* is protected.

app/admin/mcp/page.tsx: 'Aktif' status derivation happens on the server (lib/tokens.ts::status) - good. Client-side just displays; no dual-source-of-truth. Consider adding a data-testid on the just-created success-box code element to disambiguate from the docs curl example.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (sidebar link + navigation + create + success box + list row w/ badges verified via Playwright; revoke/reactivate/delete verified via API layer)

test_credentials: admin@bsagrc.co.id / BSA@GRC2026! - login succeeded on first try. Used 0 wrong-password attempts during this iteration (well under 5-lockout).

Both use BASE_URL hardcoded to the preview ingress URL. Login is single-attempt (avoid re-running in a tight loop to prevent 5/15min lockout).
